entities.name: Fukushima Azuma Baseball Stadium
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Fukushima Azuma Baseball Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Fukushima, Japan. It is currently used mostly for baseball matches. The stadium was originally opened in 1986 and has a capacity of 30,000 spectators.
